name: sustained-fast-flicking
description: Rapid pole-flicking: L0 alternates 0.0/1.0 every 10ms for 600ms, then stops dead for 900ms. This is the input pattern V2Sustained was built for — the per-slot waveform keeps oscillating while the master intensity is held at the rolling 200ms peak, and the tail shows the hold decaying once input stops.
